name: Sojourner
location: Ares Vallis, next to the Pathfinder station
tagline: I am the very first rover to drive on Mars.
discovery: I analysed the make-up of Martian rocks with my spectrometer. The landscape of Ares Vallis, strewn with pebbles and boulders, showed that a huge flood once swept through.
status_note: Silent since September 1997, when my base, the Pathfinder station, stopped communicating. I stayed close by.

presentation.title: I'm small, it's true. But I'm the one who opened the way. My name is Sojourner.
presentation.body: I'm a rover from the Mars Pathfinder mission. I am the very first rover to drive on Mars.

chapters.title: Small but a pioneer
chapters.body: I weigh just 10.6 kg, about as much as a microwave oven. I was built to prove that a small wheeled robot could explore another planet.

chapters.title: The journey
chapters.body: On 4 December 1996, I lift off from Florida, tucked inside the Mars Pathfinder lander.

chapters.title: A bouncy landing
chapters.body: On 4 July 1997, Pathfinder reaches Mars wrapped in big airbags. It bounces several times before stopping, then opens like a flower. I roll down to the ground on a small ramp.

chapters.title: Rocks with nicknames
chapters.body: I drive from rock to rock to analyse them. The team gives them fun names, like Barnacle Bill and Yogi.

chapters.title: 83 days instead of 7
chapters.body: My mission was meant to last 7 Martian days. I worked for 83! On 27 September 1997, the Pathfinder station sends its last signal. Without it, I can no longer talk to Earth.

quiz.question: How many Martian days was Sojourner's mission supposed to last?
quiz.explanation: Planned for 7 Martian days, it lasted 83.

quiz.question: How did Mars Pathfinder land on Mars?
quiz.explanation: The airbags absorbed the impact: the lander bounced several times before coming to rest.
